title: 3 public methods of ConfKeyManager lack docstrings (create_key_pair L87, add_consumer L133, remove_consumer L138)
detail: create_key_pair, add_consumer, and remove_consumer are public interface methods with no docstrings; callers cannot determine expected behaviour or error conditions from the signature alone. Add a one-line docstring to each method explaining its purpose or that it raises NotImplementedError.
